description: This file implements the SystemInfo class and related nested classes for gathering and managing system information such as network, security, location, device ID, time, and software version within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It includes methods for registration, updating, and retrieving system data, as well as handling notifications to registered clients.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Main class providing system information and notification management within the PluginHost namespace.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Internet
classes.description: Nested class managing internet connectivity details such as IP address and network type.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Security
classes.description: Nested class managing security-related information like callsign.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Location
classes.description: Nested class providing geographic location details such as timezone, country, region, city, latitude, and longitude.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Id
classes.description: Nested class handling device identification details including identifier, architecture, chipset, and firmware version.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Time
classes.description: Nested class managing time synchronization information.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Register
methods.description: Registers a notification client to receive system updates.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification client from receiving system updates.

methods.name: SystemInfo::RawDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of a network interface, used as a device ID.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Update
methods.description: Triggers an update of system information and notifies registered clients.

methods.name: SystemInfo::RecursiveList
methods.description: Recursively calls the Updated method on notification clients.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Internet::Set
methods.description: Sets internet information based on provided data.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Security::Set
methods.description: Sets security information based on provided data.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Location::Set
methods.description: Sets location information based on provided data.

methods.name: SystemInfo::BuildTreeHash
methods.description: Returns a hash representing the build tree version.
